_comment: MERGE these three keys into zones/$zone in database.rules.json in the WEB repo,
then deploy from there. This is a snippet, not a complete ruleset — do not deploy
it on its own or it will replace every other rule you have.
camIp and frame use the same device condition as the existing ts, rssi and ip keys:
the writer's devices/<uid> entry must equal the zone id, or '*'. camModel is
admin-only like name, floor and mcu — it is static hardware description, not
telemetry, so the camera does not write it and cannot. Set it once by hand at
zones/<zone>/camModel or the camera tile stays hidden, because the app gates the
tile on hasCam(z), which tests z.camModel.
Without these three keys the $zone-level "$other": {".validate": false} rejects
